### 🌟 Core Modules

1. **Explore Hub** ([`ExploreView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Explore/ExploreView.swift)):
   - Daily featured wildlife spotlight with rotating entries.
   - Seasonal migration radar alerts (e.g. Monarch butterfly flyway).
   - Biome discovery carousel (Tropical Rainforest, Alpine Tundra, Pelagic Oceans, Savannas).
   - Quick counters for field sightings, unique species recorded, and ranger badges.

2. **Field Guide & Encyclopedia** ([`FieldGuideView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Guide/FieldGuideView.swift)):
   - Instant search across common names, scientific names, and regions.
   - IUCN Red List status indicators ([`ConservationStatus`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Models/Species.swift)).
   - Detailed species sheet ([`SpeciesDetailView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Guide/SpeciesDetailView.swift)) with taxonomy tree, physical characteristics, threats, and animated vocal call player.

3. **Wildlife Radar Map** ([`WildlifeMapView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Map/WildlifeMapView.swift)):
   - Interactive MapKit map pinning field sightings with category annotations.
   - Category filters (Mammals, Birds, Reptiles, Marine Life, Amphibians, Insects).
   - Callout card inspection with 1-tap navigation to sighting details.

4. **Field Journal** ([`JournalView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Journal/JournalView.swift)):
   - Log observations with timestamp, species count, location name, coordinates, weather, and notes ([`NewSightingSheet`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Journal/NewSightingSheet.swift)).
   - Automatic persistence via [`DataStore`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Services/DataStore.swift).

5. **Biome Soundscapes** ([`SoundscapesView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Soundscapes/SoundscapesView.swift)):
   - Relaxing acoustic recordings (Amazon Canopy, Himalayan Ridge, Serengeti Dusk, Deep Pelagic Drift).
   - Dynamic animated audio wave visualizer and playback controls ([`AudioPlayerService`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Services/AudioPlayerService.swift)).

6. **AI Species Recognition** ([`FieldIdentifierView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Identifier/FieldIdentifierView.swift)):
   - Viewfinder reticle overlay simulating camera scanning with confidence scoring and quick-logging.

7. **Ranger Accolades** ([`ProfileView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Profile/ProfileView.swift) & [`AchievementsView`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild/Views/Profile/AchievementsView.swift)):
   - Automatic milestone unlocks (*First Step into the Wild*, *Avian Enthusiast*, *Apex Observer*, *Ocean Sentinel*, *Master Ranger*).

### 🛠️ How to Run in Xcode
1. Open [`Wild.xcodeproj`](https://github.com/nitinbteche/wild-ios-app/blob/main/Wild.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj) in Xcode.
2. Select any iOS Simulator (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 16) or a connected physical device.
3. Press **⌘ + R** to build and run.

*All project files and commits are saved.*
